featured_reviews.review_text: My dad's hernia surgery failed to resolve the original issue, but also developed a serious post-operative infection caused by Mycobacterium abscessus — a rare but concerning complication that has significantly affected patients’ recovery and quality of life. As per the doctor he said he had to reoperate 12 patients again which shows mere negligence. I believe there was a lack of adequate post-surgical follow-up and infection control measures. This has resulted in prolonged suffering, added medical expenses, and emotional stress. I hope this review encourages more diligence and transparency in patient care moving forward.
